patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — BigCommerce and PrestaShop share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Comparison thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose BigCommerce only if your buying job matches “Open-SaaS ecommerce platform — Core $39/mo ($29 annual), Growth $105 ($79), Scale $399 ($2” rather than PrestaShop's shape. Choose PrestaShop only if your buying job matches “Open-source PHP commerce — Classic free; Hosted from ~$26/mo annual (€24 excl. VAT) with 1” rather than BigCommerce's shape. Workflow advantage: BigCommerce leans wholesale-b2b; PrestaShop leans shared coverage. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — BigCommerce and PrestaShop share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: BigCommerce is Open-SaaS ecommerce platform — Core $39/mo ($29 annual), Growth $105 ($79), Scale $399 ($299); GMV thresholds and open payment provider fees; PrestaShop is Open-source PHP commerce — Classic free; Hosted from ~$26/mo annual (€24 excl. VAT) with 14-day trial; Enterprise quote. WooCommerce keeps t.
- Company-size focus: BigCommerce (small-business, mid-market, enterprise) vs PrestaShop (small-business, mid-market).
- Workflow coverage skew: BigCommerce-leaning wholesale-b2b vs PrestaShop-leaning —.
- Researched limits: BigCommerce — 2026 GMV thresholds and open payment provider fees complicate TCO versus headline subscription; PrestaShop — Classic TCO (hosting, modules, agency) is not $0 even when the license is free.

Limitations — BigCommerce: 2026 GMV thresholds and open payment provider fees complicate TCO versus headline subscription; Native POS/retail depth trails Shopify/Square for omnichannel-first merchants; PrestaShop: Classic TCO (hosting, modules, agency) is not $0 even when the license is free; POS / omnichannel is module-dependent, not a native retail bundle.

Poor-fit cases: BigCommerce is a poor fit when that limitation bites: 2026 GMV thresholds and open payment provider fees complicate TCO versus headline subscription · PrestaShop is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Classic TCO (hosting, modules, agency) is not $0 even when the license is free · Avoid BigCommerce if you actually need PrestaShop's motion (Open-source PHP commerce — Classic free; Hosted from ~$26/mo annual (€24 excl. V)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
